title: SS United States 遠洋客輪工程史
titleEn: SS United States ocean-liner engineering history
summary: 以SS United States歷史客輪案例，練習用現代能量與材料概念解讀史料，避免把歷史宣傳性能或展示資料當成實船計算輸入。 各單元為獨立縮尺練習，串接的是驗證流程，不是同一實船的校準數位分身。
summaryEn: Use the historic SS United States to interpret archives through modern energy and materials concepts, without using promotional claims or exhibit information as real-vessel calculation inputs. Units are independent scaled exercises connected by a verification workflow, not a calibrated digital twin of one vessel.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創船舶海洋教學。數值均為明示假設，不是同名船舶的實測規格、法規認證或實船操作參數。以虛構資料、教學模型與常壓桌面練習學習，排除武器、戰術與載人下潛操作。
scopeEn: Original marine teaching based on public principles. All numbers are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vessel specifications, certification criteria or real-ship operating parameters. Learning uses synthetic data, teaching models and unpressurized desktop exercises, excluding weapons, tactics and crewed diving operations.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 核對重量與容積指標：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Check mass versus volume-based measures: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 核對重量與容積指標 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Check mass versus volume-based measures and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 核對重量與容積指標：靜浮平衡時船舶總質量等於排開水的質量；載重、設備、燃料和船體質量應分欄。 本步以「船舶排水質量帳」對應案例介面，先標記輸入、輸出與未計入項目。
steps.instructionEn: Check mass versus volume-based measures: At static flotation, vessel mass equals displaced-water mass; payload, equipment, fuel and hull belong in separate ledger columns. Use Vessel displacement mass ledger to describe the case interface, marking input, output and omitted terms first.
steps.observation: 各單元數值是獨立練習，不能合併成同一實船的質量或能源帳。本單元獨立的原創縮尺教學資料，不是SS United States 遠洋客輪工程史實際規格：ρ=1025 kg/m³，排水體積V=520 m³。式 m=ρV，基準結果 533 t。條件：僅靜水質量平衡；不等於總噸位，也未判定完整穩度。
steps.observationEn: Numbers in different units are independent exercises and cannot be combined into one vessel mass or energy ledger. Independent original scaled data for this unit, not actual specifications of SS United States ocean-liner engineering history: ρ=1025 kg/m³, displacement volume V=520 m³. Formula m=ρV gives 533 t. Conditions: Static mass balance only; this is not gross tonnage and does not establish intact stability.
steps.failure: 把總噸位當質量會混淆容積指標與重量，先檢查資料欄位定義。 若案例資料尚缺，先標為未驗證，不能用同名船舶的外觀照片填補數值。
steps.failureEn: Treating gross tonnage as mass confuses a volume-based index with weight; inspect field definitions first. Mark missing case data as unverified rather than filling values from a photograph of the named vessel.
steps.check: 以四欄裝載表加總後與排水質量比對，標出尚未計入的人員、淡水與備品。 本案例另須檢查「核對重量與容積指標」與前一步資料是否使用同一時間、單位與系統邊界。
steps.checkEn: Sum a four-column loading table and compare with displacement mass; flag omitted people, freshwater and spares. Also check that Check mass versus volume-based measures and the preceding step share time, units and system boundaries.

Use Vessel displacement mass ledger to describe the case interface, marking input, output and omitted terms first.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 本單元任務：核對重量與容積指標。在歷史船舶史料、假設載荷與阻力試算台完成資料或紙面模型練習。只增加排水體積10%，重算可平衡的質量，不推定可額外載客。 算式區的基準值為533，改變後為586.3 t。先預測方向，再計算、記錄原式與新式，最後寫下仍需量測的資料。
knowledge.textEn: Unit task: Check mass versus volume-based measures. Complete a data or paper-model exercise at the Historical vessel records and hypothetical load/drag calculation desk. Increase displacement volume alone by 10% and recalculate equilibrium mass without inferring additional passenger capacity. Baseline 533 changes to 586.3 t. Predict direction, calculate, retain both expressions and record the measurement still needed.

Independent original scaled data for this unit, not actual specifications of SS United States ocean-liner engineering history: Displacement mass m=832 t, GM=0.8 m, φ=0.05 rad. Formula M≈mgGMφ gives 326.4768 kN·m. Conditions: Uses sinφ≈φ at small angle, excluding free surfaces, wind, waves and damage; not a permission to sail.
steps.failure: 把角度5直接代入rad公式會嚴重高估；先查角度單位，再查GM來源。 若案例資料尚缺，先標為未驗證，不能用同名船舶的外觀照片填補數值。
steps.failureEn: Entering 5 degrees as 5 radians severely overestimates moment; check angular units and then the GM source. Mark missing case data as unverified rather than filling values from a photograph of the named vessel.
steps.check: 將橫搖角由度轉rad，再用同一假設比較回復力矩；以紙面重心上移情境討論GM下降。 本案例另須檢查「比較材料輕量化與重心假設」與前一步資料是否使用同一時間、單位與系統邊界。
steps.checkEn: Convert roll angle from degrees to radians and compare restoring moment under fixed assumptions; discuss lower GM when a paper-model center of gravity rises. Also check that Compare lightweight materials and center assumptions and the preceding step share time, units and system boundaries.

knowledge.title: 比較材料輕量化與重心假設
knowledge.titleEn: Compare lightweight materials and center assumptions
knowledge.text: 把角度5直接代入rad公式會嚴重高估；先查角度單位，再查GM來源。 若案例資料尚缺，先標為未驗證，不能用同名船舶的外觀照片填補數值。
knowledge.textEn: Entering 5 degrees as 5 radians severely overestimates moment; check angular units and then the GM source. Mark missing case data as unverified rather than filling values from a photograph of the named vessel.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 本單元任務：比較材料輕量化與重心假設。在歷史船舶史料、假設載荷與阻力試算台完成資料或紙面模型練習。只增加排水質量10%，保持假設GM與角度固定；另說明實船GM可能也會改變。 算式區的基準值為326.4768，改變後為359.12448 kN·m。先預測方向，再計算、記錄原式與新式，最後寫下仍需量測的資料。
knowledge.textEn: Unit task: Compare lightweight materials and center assumptions. Complete a data or paper-model exercise at the Historical vessel records and hypothetical load/drag calculation desk. Increase mass alone by 10% at fixed assumed GM and angle, then explain that real-vessel GM may also change. Baseline 326.4768 changes to 359.12448 kN·m. Predict direction, calculate, retain both expressions and record the measurement still needed.

quiz.question: 哪一項正確描述本步應診斷的失效原因？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement correctly describes the failure to diagnose?
options: 看到結果符合預期就可省略條件、單位與原始資料。
初始GM為正就代表任何傾角都不會翻覆。
把角度5直接代入rad公式會嚴重高估；先查角度單位，再查GM來源。
optionsEn: An expected result allows conditions, units and raw data to be omitted.
Positive initial GM means capsizing is impossible at every heel angle.
Entering 5 degrees as 5 radians severely overestimates moment; check angular units and then the GM source.
quiz.explanation: 把角度5直接代入rad公式會嚴重高估；先查角度單位，再查GM來源。 將橫搖角由度轉rad，再用同一假設比較回復力矩；以紙面重心上移情境討論GM下降。 本案例另須檢查「比較材料輕量化與重心假設」與前一步資料是否使用同一時間、單位與系統邊界。
quiz.explanationEn: Entering 5 degrees as 5 radians severely overestimates moment; check angular units and then the GM source. Convert roll angle from degrees to radians and compare restoring moment under fixed assumptions; discuss lower GM when a paper-model center of gravity rises. Also check that Compare lightweight materials and center assumptions and the preceding step share time, units and system boundaries.
